controls.procedure: Resolve target identity and compare inherited delivery metadata against the immutable base before allowing evidence reuse.
controls.expected: A base-identical artifact bound to another delivery is rejected before reuse.
controls.observed: The current recovery classified the inherited package as foreign and rebuilt the target-bound packet.

controls.procedure: Compare the handoff object at candidate head with the same path on the immutable base before attributing origin to the current delivery.
controls.expected: An unchanged foreign certificate is inherited repository state, not current delivery evidence.
controls.observed: The immutable-base origin controls passed and the inherited foreign handoff was not accepted for the current target.
